item.title: Police arrest 3 gang members in Rohini
item.description: New Delhi: Three alleged members of a gang led by Himanshu Bhau were arrested by Delhi Police’s Special Cell during a late-night operation in northwest Delhi’ Rohini, officials said on Wednesday. Police claimed that the action averted a serious criminal incident. The arrests were made on January 3 after receiving inputs about the trio’s movements across the city with illegal firearms at the direction of Himanshu Bhau, police said. item.title: DNA test confirms 2020 fire victim wasa man; murder case registered
item.description: Shahjahanpur: A DNA report received nearly five years after a fatal blaze has turned a closed fire investigation into a murder probe. Police here have booked three people for murder after scientific testing confirmed that charred remains -- originally dismissed by the police as animal remains -- were those of an 18-year-old man. item.title: Dhanush’s film with Vignesh Raja titled ‘Kara’, makers unveil title on Pongal
item.description: Director Vignesh Raja also confirmed the title on his social media handle, describing the film as “an emotionally rooted suspense thriller” and revealing that the team is aiming for a summer release. He wrote, “D54 is Kara. An emotionally rooted suspense thriller. We are coming this summer. #HappyPongal #HappySankranti.”

item.title: Vijayawada West Bypass Opens for Traffic
item.description: In a gesture to celebrate Sankranthi, authorities have inaugurated the Vijayawada West Bypass, which connects Kaja in the Mangalagiri mandal of Guntur district to Pedavutapalli in Krishna district.

item.title: James Cameron confirms Michelle Yeoh’s appearance in future Avatar films
item.description: Cameron stated that Yeoh is set to be part of Avatar 4 and potentially Avatar 5, but clarified that her appearance will depend on whether the franchise moves forward as planned.
